.Horizontal column alignment
[cols="<,^,>"]
|===
|Left |Center |Right
|===

.Vertical column alignment
[cols=".<,.^,.>,<"]
|===
|Top |Middle |Bottom
|This deliberately long cell makes the row tall enough to show each vertical alignment.
|===

.Cell alignment overrides
[cols=">.>,>.>,>.>,>.>"]
|===
<|Left
^|Center
>|Right
|This deliberately long cell makes the row tall enough to show horizontal overrides while retaining bottom alignment.

.<|Top
.^|Middle
.>|Bottom
|This deliberately long cell makes the row tall enough to show vertical overrides while retaining right alignment.

<.<|Left and top
^.^|Center and middle
>.>|Right and bottom
|This deliberately long cell makes the row tall enough to show combined alignment overrides.
|===

.Cell alignment after spans
[cols=">,<,^"]
|===
2+|Spans logical columns one and two
.>|Bottom in logical column three

.2+|Spans two rows
|First row, logical column two
|First row, logical column three

.>|Bottom in logical column two
|This deliberately long cell makes the second row tall enough to show its first real cell at the bottom.
|===

.Cell alignment in table sections
[%header%footer,cols=">.>,<"]
|===
^.^|Header center and middle
.>|Header bottom

<.<|Body left and top
|This deliberately long cell makes the body row tall enough to show its first cell at the top.

^.>|Footer center and bottom
.<|Footer top
|===
